_purpose: HTTP request bodies in the website's NATIVE Gravity Forms entry shape (TAD rev 11, ADR-051, Appendix C) for the deployed intake flow, REV | Intake | WordPress to Dataverse. IN-01 is the 2026-09-25 sample verbatim; every other case is synthetic and describes no real person.
_supersedes: The six old-contract cases (submission_id / first_name / option-value integers) - no sender ever sent that shape, and every one of them would now be rejected with a 400.
_howExpectedValuesWereDerived: By running each body through a local interpreter of the flow definition (eager if() semantics, the stricter of the two recorded readings) against dev-scoring-settings.json, with the local-authority and city registers mocked EMPTY. This is NOT a platform verification level: the DEV replay of these bodies is what closes A-INT-01..06 (Dev Summary section 10). A live run will also derive a city and a local authority, so its note carries no 'city:' sentence where the register has the outward code.
_howToRun: Seed the 18 rev_setting rows first (provisioning/dataverse/seed-settings.ps1 -Env dev); the flow stops with ConfigurationIncomplete otherwise.
Obtain a client-credentials token for rev-wordpress-intake (scope https://service.flow.microsoft.com//.default).
POST each body with Authorization: Bearer <token> and x-rev-client-id: <the client id>, except IN-04 (wrong x-rev-client-id).

Every non-fatal defect at once: an unknown title, an unknown hear-about-us label beside a known one, a £-prefixed amount (accepted), a non-numeric amount, a decimal life-satisfaction answer, a non-Yes/No answer and a missing always-shown key (gender). Accepted with 201; each defect is an empty column plus one sentence in rev_intakereviewnote. Scoring is withheld because a scored answer is missing (FR-022).
